context:
Goal: stop the draft-PR check's false alarm on a python heredoc that mentions `gh pr create` in backticks.
Problem (rule): the lane's fix was held after round 3 at negative net value, and a held change gets no more work without your word. It opened a hole: after a kept heredoc body, `nohup bash run.sh &` or `npm start &` passes, where main refuses them as a detached launch.
Based on (measured): the lane's runs. #1642 still refuses the incident; the cause is shell_run_texts reading python backtick spans.
Departs from: main refuses the incident's python heredoc as a draft-PR create — a fixes it in #1642's stacked PR and drops the held change; b re-lanes the held change with the hole fixed.

options.gain: The false alarm goes, and no hole opens.
options.how: The stacked PR, already queued, treats python backticks as text, not shell. The held branch stays archived.
options.label: Drop the held change; fix the incident in #1642's stacked PR
options.lose: Debt heredoc-written-run-false-alarm (a data heredoc kept in view) stays open.

options.how: A new lane at round 1 fixes the detached-launch hole, then runs full review rounds.
options.label: Re-lane the held change with the hole fixed
options.lose: One more lane on the shared heredoc code that caused the hole, so the risk of a new hole repeats.

ref: step draft-pr-guard-heredoc; decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 (net-value hold after round 3); PR #1642; archived branch archive/draft-pr-guard-heredoc
title: What happens to the held draft-PR heredoc fix?
why: The coordinator and the lane recommend a: it removes the false alarm with no new hole, and the debt stays filed.
